name: Sarah Jenkins
psychographics: Treats tech as a hobby budget; prioritizes experiences over owning the latest device.
current_solutions: Pixel 7a, Cash App for budgeting, YouTube Music Premium, local thrift stores for phone cases
frustration: Got locked out of her Google account at 2am yesterday because of a suspicious login attempt from another state - lost access to her photos and saved passwords for six hours.
decision_style: scrolls TikTok for 'best cheap tech' recommendations, trusts micro-influencers more than brand websites
voice: Blunt, short, uses a lot of 'like' and 'literally' but cuts straight to the point about battery life or price
